engineering_objects: Build a physical full-vehicle Formula Student model with a six-degree-of-freedom chassis, four independently contacting tires, front and rear suspension with springs, dampers and anti-roll behavior, steering, four-wheel propulsion, and wheel braking.

The same connected vehicle must also support a straight-line acceleration-and-braking event so that longitudinal and lateral tire forces, load transfer, suspension motion, and body attitude arise from the physical mechanism rather than prescribed traces.
The vehicle must remain physically stable throughout these ranges.

interfaces.name: VehicleState
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Record complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named VehicleState, ReferenceState, WheelForces, TireSlip, SuspensionState, and DriverCommands. interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Record complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named VehicleState, ReferenceState, WheelForces, TireSlip, SuspensionState, and DriverCommands. ReferenceState has 3 channels: target speed (m/s), reference yaw (rad), and reference distance (m).

interfaces.name: WheelForces

interfaces.range_or_shape: Record complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named VehicleState, ReferenceState, WheelForces, TireSlip, SuspensionState, and DriverCommands. WheelForces has 12 channels: Fx for FL, FR, RL, RR; Fy in the same order; then Fz in the same order, all in N.
